thread:
alex: Heads-up — need cross-team alignment on new KV/prefix cache effectiveness metrics for Console dashboards. Goal: actionable signals for routing/quotas/rollouts. Can runtime + infra + console chime in with constraints? I sketched a minimal set below.

maria: runtime: we can emit per-tenant + per-model counters: kv_prefix.cache_hits_total, kv_prefix.cache_misses_total, kv_prefix.cache_evictions_total. Also current_kv_entries gauge and a reuse_count histogram. For cardinality, recommend sampling high-cardinality prefix strings to object storage instead of metrics.

jon: infra: ingest pipeline can handle it but we need strict naming + tag set. Required tags: tenant, model, route, host_pool. Do NOT add per-request tags. We'll also want a 'period' label for rollups. I'll run a cardinality projection once we agree.

priya: console: UI needs aggregated signals first — tenant-level hit rate, model-level breakdown, and eviction trends. Also a panel for "reuse distribution" (p50/p90/p99). Link to sampled prefix dumps for deep-dive. Pre-aggregate 1m/5m to keep dashboards responsive.

sam: small ask — do we plan to expose top-n prefixes by traffic? That could be privacy-sensitive and very high-cardinality. Maybe only show top-10 per-tenant and link to the sampled dump.

maria: agreed. We'll emit a low-volume debug stream (S3) with full prefix text + context for privacy review and investigative use; send only prefix hash/short-id to metrics.

lina: SRE perspective: we want alerts. Example: tenant hit_rate drop >20% vs baseline for 10m; eviction storm when evictions/sec spikes by 5x baseline. Also track eviction-to-hit ratio. Need numbers to validate thresholds.

alex: Proposed metric proto (for discussion):
```
kv_prefix.cache_hits_total{tenant,model,route,host_pool}
kv_prefix.cache_misses_total{tenant,model,route,host_pool}
kv_prefix.cache_evictions_total{tenant,model,route,host_pool}
kv_prefix.current_entries_gauge{tenant,model,host_pool}
kv_prefix.reuse_count_histogram{tenant,model,route}
kv_prefix.prefix_sample_dump (not in metrics backend; S3 link emitted)
```

priya: Dashboard panels I'd like: 1) hit rate heatmap by model x tenant 2) eviction waterfall by route 3) reuse distribution percentiles 4) top-10 prefixes contributing to cache traffic (link to sampled dump) 5) per-tenant alert status + runbook link.

jon: ingestion notes: please add 'period' label for rollup granularity (e.g., 60s/300s). Cardinality estimate request: send expected cardinality = tenants * models * routes * host_pools. If we include resource-level (instance) tag, that explodes. Keep that out.

alex: action items: maria -> implement emitter + sampled dump config and post example by EOD Tue. jon -> ingest RFC + cardinality estimates by Wed. priya -> dashboard mockups (with fake data) by Thu. lina -> propose alert thresholds and draft runbook. sam -> document quota/routing implications and privacy considerations.

maria: ack — posting an emitter example shortly. We'll default to 1:10 sampling for prefix text and 1:1 for aggregated counters.

devops-bot: runtime emitter build succeeded: runtime/metrics-emitter v2.1 deployed to staging.

maria: example emitter snippet:
```
metrics.emit_counter("kv_prefix.cache_hits_total", 1, tags={"tenant": tenant, "model": model, "route": route, "host_pool": pool})
metrics.emit_gauge("kv_prefix.current_entries_gauge", current_entries, tags=...)
// prefix sample: write to s3 with tenant+shortid, not to metrics backend
```

jon: RFC draft link: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/kv-prefix-metrics (WIP) — will add cardinality table and estimated ingest QPS.

priya: I'll start prototyping dashboard panels with fake data and wire the sample dump link to a staging S3 viewer. Will share screenshots in #eng-platform once ready.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or we'll do a quick sync Fri 10am. :thumbsup:
